# API Design — Florida Mental Health App

**Base URL (dev):** `http://localhost:8080/api`
**Live docs:** `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html` (generated by springdoc-openapi)

---

## Conventions

**Authentication.** Every endpoint requires a bearer token except those
marked **public**:

```
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
```

A missing or invalid token returns **401**. A valid token without the
required role returns **403**.

**Identity.** Where an endpoint acts on "the current user", that identity
is taken from the JWT via the security context. It is never accepted as a
path variable, query parameter, or body field — passing someone else's id
has no effect because the server never reads one.

**Pagination.** List endpoints accept `page` (0-based, default 0) and
`size` (default 20, max 100), and return a Spring `Page` envelope:

```json
{
  "content": [ ... ],
  "pageable": { "pageNumber": 0, "pageSize": 20 },
  "totalElements": 35,
  "totalPages": 2,
  "first": true,
  "last": false
}
```

**Errors.** Every error returns the same shape
(`ReportDtos.ErrorResponse`), produced by `GlobalExceptionHandler`:

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-01T16:24:03",
  "status": 404,
  "error": "Not Found",
  "message": "Provider 9999 not found",
  "path": "/api/providers/9999"
}
```

Validation failures return **400** with field-level detail:

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-01T16:24:03",
  "status": 400,
  "error": "Bad Request",
  "message": "Validation failed",
  "path": "/api/auth/register",
  "fieldErrors": {
    "email": "must be a well-formed email address",
    "password": "size must be between 8 and 72"
  }
}
```

**CORS.** The API is called from a separate origin in development, so
`SecurityConfig` allows any loopback port — `http://localhost:[*]` and
`http://127.0.0.1:[*]` — rather than one fixed port, because Vite moves
to 5174 and upward when 5173 is taken. Still an allowlist, not `*`:
nothing off the machine can call the API from a browser. Preflight
`OPTIONS` is permitted on all paths.

**Status codes used.**

| Code | Meaning in this API |
|---|---|
| 200 | Successful read or update |
| 201 | Resource created (body includes the new resource) |
| 204 | Successful delete, no body |
| 400 | Validation failure, or a business rule rejected the request |
| 401 | Missing, malformed or expired token |
| 403 | Authenticated but not permitted |
| 404 | Resource does not exist |
| 405 | Method not supported on that path |
| 409 | Conflict — duplicate email, duplicate license, duplicate open referral |
| 415 | Content-Type is not `application/json` |
| 500 | Unexpected server error (logged; no stack trace in the response) |

`GlobalExceptionHandler` declares a handler per case rather than relying
on Spring's defaults. Several of these had to be named explicitly:
`HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException` *implements* the `ErrorResponse`
interface but does not *extend* `ErrorResponseException`, so a generic
handler never matched it and the catch-all reported 500 instead of 405.
`NoResourceFoundException` needed the same treatment, or every 404 in the
application surfaced as a server error.

**Enumerated values.**

- `credential` — `PSYCHIATRIST`, `PSYCHIATRIC_ARNP`, `PSYCHOLOGIST`, `LMHC`, `LCSW`, `LMFT`, `REGISTERED_INTERN`, `CAP`, `PEER_SPECIALIST`
- `orgType` — `PRIVATE_PRACTICE`, `GROUP_PRACTICE`, `COMMUNITY_MENTAL_HEALTH_CENTER`, `HOSPITAL`, `CRISIS_STABILIZATION_UNIT`, `RESIDENTIAL`, `FQHC`, `TELEHEALTH_ONLY`, `NONPROFIT`
- `planType` — `MEDICAID`, `MEDICARE`, `COMMERCIAL`, `MARKETPLACE`, `SLIDING_SCALE`, `SELF_PAY`
- `referral status` — `PENDING`, `ACCEPTED`, `WAITLISTED`, `DECLINED`, `WITHDRAWN`, `CLOSED`
- `contactPreference` — `EMAIL`, `PHONE`, `TEXT`

---

## 1. Authentication

### POST `/api/auth/register` — public

Creates an account with `ROLE_USER`. Password is hashed with BCrypt
(strength 11) before storage.

**Request** — `AuthDtos.RegisterRequest`

```json
{
  "firstName": "Alicia",
  "lastName": "Moreno",
  "email": "alicia.moreno@example.com",
  "password": "at-least-8-chars"
}
```

| Field | Rules |
|---|---|
| `firstName` | required, ≤ 50 |
| `lastName` | required, ≤ 50 |
| `email` | required, valid email, ≤ 120, unique |
| `password` | required, 8–72 characters |

**201** — `AuthDtos.AuthResponse` (same shape as login; the account is
usable immediately)

**400** validation failure · **409** email already registered

---

### POST `/api/auth/login` — public

**Request** — `AuthDtos.LoginRequest`

```json
{ "email": "alicia.moreno@example.com", "password": "..." }
```

**200** — `AuthDtos.AuthResponse`

```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...",
  "email": "alicia.moreno@example.com",
  "fullName": "Alicia Moreno",
  "roles": ["ROLE_USER"]
}
```

**401** bad credentials. The response does not distinguish "no such
email" from "wrong password" — that distinction is an account-enumeration
leak.

## 2. Profile

### GET `/api/profile` — USER, ADMIN

Returns the current user's profile. Creates nothing; a user who has never
saved a profile gets a response with null preference fields.

**200** — `ProfileDtos.Response`

```json
{
  "userId": 3,
  "fullName": "Alicia Moreno",
  "email": "alicia.moreno@example.com",
  "phone": "305-555-0211",
  "preferredCounty": "Miami-Dade",
  "preferredLanguage": "Spanish",
  "insurancePlan": "Sunshine Health (Medicaid)",
  "prefersTelehealth": false,
  "contactPreference": "EMAIL"
}
```

### PUT `/api/profile` — USER, ADMIN

Creates the profile on first call, updates thereafter.

**Request** — `ProfileDtos.Request`

```json
{
  "phone": "305-555-0211",
  "preferredCountyId": 43,
  "preferredLanguageId": 2,
  "insurancePlanId": 1,
  "prefersTelehealth": false,
  "contactPreference": "EMAIL"
}
```

All preference ids are optional (null clears the preference).
`contactPreference` must be one of the enumerated values.

**200** — `ProfileDtos.Response` · **400** validation · **404** a
referenced county / language / plan does not exist

## 3. Catalog (reference data)

Reads are open to any authenticated user. Writes are **ADMIN only**.
These collections are small and near-static, so reads are unpaginated.

| Method | Path | Role | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/counties` | USER, ADMIN | 200 — `CountyResponse[]` (67) |
| GET | `/api/specialties` | USER, ADMIN | 200 — `SpecialtyResponse[]` |
| GET | `/api/populations` | USER, ADMIN | 200 — `PopulationResponse[]` |
| GET | `/api/languages` | USER, ADMIN | 200 — `LanguageResponse[]` |
| GET | `/api/insurance-plans` | USER, ADMIN | 200 — `InsurancePlanResponse[]` |
| GET | `/api/organizations` | USER, ADMIN | 200 — paged `OrganizationResponse` |
| GET | `/api/organizations/{id}` | USER, ADMIN | 200 / 404 |
| POST | `/api/specialties` | ADMIN | 201 / 400 / 409 |
| POST | `/api/organizations` | ADMIN | 201 / 400 / 409 |
| PUT | `/api/organizations/{id}` | ADMIN | 200 / 400 / 404 |

**`CountyResponse`**

```json
{ "id": 43, "name": "Miami-Dade", "region": "Southern",
  "managingEntity": "Thriving Mind South Florida" }
```

**`OrganizationRequest`**

```json
{
  "name": "Example Brickell Behavioral Associates",
  "orgType": "GROUP_PRACTICE",
  "countyId": 43,
  "addressLine1": "1450 Brickell Bay Dr, Suite 310",
  "addressLine2": null,
  "city": "Miami",
  "postalCode": "33131",
  "phone": "305-555-0148",
  "website": "https://example.org/brickell",
  "bakerActReceivingFacility": false
}
```

`name` required and unique (≤ 160) · `orgType` must be an enumerated
value · `countyId` required and must exist.

## 4. Providers

### GET `/api/providers/search` — USER, ADMIN

The core endpoint. Every filter is optional; omitting one disables that
clause. Combining filters narrows with AND.

| Query param | Type | Effect when omitted |
|---|---|---|
| `countyId` | long | any county |
| `specialtyId` | long | any clinical focus |
| `languageId` | long | any language |
| `insurancePlanId` | long | any plan |
| `populationId` | long | any population served |
| `telehealth` | boolean | both telehealth and in-person |
| `acceptingOnly` | boolean (default `false`) | includes providers not accepting |
| `page`, `size` | int | 0, 20 |

Example:

```
GET /api/providers/search?countyId=43&specialtyId=4&languageId=2
    &insurancePlanId=1&telehealth=true&acceptingOnly=true&page=0&size=20
```

**200** — paged `ProviderDtos.Summary`

```json
{
  "id": 4,
  "fullName": "Sofia Delgado",
  "credential": "LCSW",
  "organization": "Example Coral Way Counseling Center",
  "county": "Miami-Dade",
  "offersTelehealth": true,
  "acceptingNewClients": true,
  "openSlots": 6,
  "typicalWaitDays": 7
}
```

Inactive providers are never returned. The underlying query uses
`SELECT DISTINCT` because joining four collection tables would otherwise
duplicate a provider matching more than one value per filter.

### GET `/api/providers/{id}` — USER, ADMIN

**200** — `ProviderDtos.Response` (full detail, including the four
collections as name arrays) · **404**

```json
{
  "id": 4,
  "firstName": "Sofia",
  "lastName": "Delgado",
  "credential": "LCSW",
  "licenseNumber": "FL-LCSW-31092",
  "bio": "Trauma-informed clinical social work with adults and couples.",
  "yearsExperience": 7,
  "organization": "Example Coral Way Counseling Center",
  "orgType": "PRIVATE_PRACTICE",
  "county": "Miami-Dade",
  "city": "Miami",
  "offersTelehealth": true,
  "offersInPerson": true,
  "acceptingNewClients": true,
  "openSlots": 6,
  "waitlistCount": 0,
  "typicalWaitDays": 7,
  "specialties": ["PTSD & Trauma", "Relationship & Family", "Depression & Mood Disorders"],
  "populations": ["Adults", "Couples"],
  "languages": ["English", "Spanish"],
  "insurancePlans": ["Self-Pay", "Sunshine Health (Medicaid)", "Simply Healthcare (Medicaid)", "Florida Blue"]
}
```

### Shortlist

| Method | Path | Role | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/providers/saved` | USER, ADMIN | 200 — `SavedResponse[]`, current user only |
| POST | `/api/providers/{id}/save` | USER, ADMIN | 201 / 404 / 409 already saved |
| DELETE | `/api/providers/{id}/save` | USER, ADMIN | 204 / 404 not saved |

`POST` accepts an optional body: `{ "note": "Speaks Spanish, close to work" }`

### Directory management — ADMIN only

| Method | Path | Result |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/providers` | 201 / 400 / 409 duplicate license |
| PUT | `/api/providers/{id}` | 200 / 400 / 404 |
| PATCH | `/api/providers/{id}/capacity` | 200 / 400 / 404 |
| DELETE | `/api/providers/{id}` | 204 / 404 |

**`ProviderDtos.Request`** (POST and PUT)

```json
{
  "firstName": "Sofia",
  "lastName": "Delgado",
  "credential": "LCSW",
  "licenseNumber": "FL-LCSW-31092",
  "organizationId": 2,
  "bio": "...",
  "yearsExperience": 7,
  "offersTelehealth": true,
  "offersInPerson": true,
  "acceptingNewClients": true,
  "openSlots": 6,
  "typicalWaitDays": 7,
  "specialtyIds": [4, 19, 2],
  "populationIds": [3, 5],
  "languageIds": [1, 2],
  "insurancePlanIds": [16, 1, 2, 9]
}
```

**`ProviderDtos.CapacityRequest`** (PATCH) — the endpoint a navigator
actually uses day to day:

```json
{ "openSlots": 3, "acceptingNewClients": true, "note": "Two intakes opened this week" }
```

**DELETE is a soft delete.** It sets `is_active = false`. A hard delete
is impossible for any provider with referral history — the foreign key
from `referral_requests` is `ON DELETE RESTRICT` — and losing that
history to delete a row would be the wrong trade.

## 5. Referrals

### POST `/api/referrals` — USER, ADMIN

Submits a request. Created as `PENDING`, with a creation history row
written in the same transaction.

**Request** — `ReferralDtos.Request`

```json
{
  "providerId": 4,
  "message": "Looking for a Spanish-speaking counselor, weekday evenings if possible.",
  "preferredContact": "EMAIL"
}
```

`providerId` required and must exist · `message` optional, ≤ 2000 ·
`preferredContact` required, enumerated.

**201** — `ReferralDtos.Response`
**400** validation · **404** no such provider
**409** the current user already has a `PENDING` request to this provider

> The 409 enforces a rule MySQL cannot express: there is no partial
> unique index for "unique only when status = 'PENDING'", so
> `ReferralService` checks it. See ADR 0003.

### GET `/api/referrals/mine` — USER, ADMIN

Current user's referrals, newest first. Paginated.

**200** — paged `ReferralDtos.Response`

### GET `/api/referrals/{id}` — owner or ADMIN

**200** — `ReferralDtos.Response`, including the full history array
**403** authenticated as someone who neither owns it nor holds ADMIN
**404**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "status": "ACCEPTED",
  "providerId": 1,
  "providerName": "Elena Vasquez",
  "organization": "Example Brickell Behavioral Associates",
  "clientName": "Alicia Moreno",
  "message": "Looking for a Spanish-speaking counselor...",
  "preferredContact": "EMAIL",
  "submittedAt": "2026-09-08T09:15:00",
  "resolvedAt": "2026-09-09T14:20:00",
  "resolvedBy": "Dana Whitfield",
  "history": [
    { "fromStatus": null, "toStatus": "PENDING",
      "note": "Request submitted by client",
      "changedBy": "Alicia Moreno", "createdAt": "2026-09-08T09:15:00" },
    { "fromStatus": "PENDING", "toStatus": "ACCEPTED",
      "note": "Open slot confirmed; intake scheduled",
      "changedBy": "Dana Whitfield", "createdAt": "2026-09-09T14:20:00" }
  ]
}
```

### POST `/api/referrals/{id}/withdraw` — owner only

**200** — updated `ReferralDtos.Response` with status `WITHDRAWN`
**400** the referral is not `PENDING` · **403** not the owner · **404**

The history row for a withdrawal is attributed to the client, not to
staff — it is the client's own action.

### GET `/api/referrals/queue` — ADMIN

The navigator work queue.

| Query param | Default |
|---|---|
| `status` | `PENDING` |
| `page`, `size` | 0, 20 |

Ordered **oldest first**, deliberately: the queue exists so nothing ages
out of sight.

**200** — paged `ReferralDtos.Response`

### POST `/api/referrals/{id}/decision` — ADMIN

The transactional core of the application.

**Request** — `ReferralDtos.DecisionRequest`

```json
{ "status": "ACCEPTED", "note": "Open slot confirmed; intake scheduled" }
```

`status` must be `ACCEPTED`, `WAITLISTED` or `DECLINED` · `note`
optional, ≤ 255.

**200** — updated `ReferralDtos.Response`
**400** the referral is already resolved, or `status` is not a valid
decision · **404**

**Behavior, in one transaction:**

1. The provider is re-read inside the transaction.
2. If `ACCEPTED` was requested but `openSlots` has reached zero since
   the client submitted, the referral resolves to **`WAITLISTED`**
   instead. The response reports the status that was actually applied,
   so the caller is never misled. Capacity is never overbooked and the
   request is never silently dropped.
3. A real accept decrements `openSlots`; a waitlist increments
   `waitlistCount`.
4. `status`, `resolvedAt` and `resolvedBy` are set.
5. A history row (`PENDING` → new status) is written.

If any step fails, all of it rolls back: no half-decremented capacity,
and no status change without its audit row.

## 6. Reports — ADMIN only

### GET `/api/reports/referrals?from=&to=`

Dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Both optional; omitting them covers all time.

**200** — `ReportDtos.ReferralSummary`

```json
{ "from": "2026-09-01", "to": "2026-09-30", "total": 10,
  "pending": 3, "accepted": 3, "waitlisted": 2,
  "declined": 1, "withdrawn": 1 }
```

### GET `/api/reports/access-gap`

How many providers **currently accepting new clients** take each
insurance plan type. Counts distinct providers, not plans — a clinician
who takes four Medicaid MCOs counts once toward `MEDICAID`.

**200** — `ReportDtos.AccessGapRow[]`

Computed from the seeded dataset (28 of 35 providers accepting):

```json
[ { "planType": "SELF_PAY",      "acceptingProviders": 28 },
  { "planType": "MEDICAID",      "acceptingProviders": 14 },
  { "planType": "SLIDING_SCALE", "acceptingProviders": 13 },
  { "planType": "COMMERCIAL",    "acceptingProviders": 11 },
  { "planType": "MEDICARE",      "acceptingProviders": 7 },
  { "planType": "MARKETPLACE",   "acceptingProviders": 6 } ]
```

> **Read this honestly.** In the real world the usual finding is that
> fewer clinicians accept Medicaid than commercial insurance. **This
> sample does not reproduce that** — here Medicaid (14) runs ahead of
> commercial (11), because the seed data was written to exercise the
> query, not to model the shortage.
>
> What the endpoint demonstrates is the *mechanism*: a number that falls
> out of data the directory already holds, with no separate survey and
> no extra form for anyone to fill in. Pointed at real intake data it
> would show whatever is actually true. Claiming it already shows a
> Medicaid gap would be claiming something this dataset does not
> support.

### GET `/api/reports/county-capacity`

Every county with at least one provider. Counts **all** active
providers, not only those accepting — a county with providers who are
all full is exactly what this report exists to make visible.

**200** — `ReportDtos.CountyCapacityRow[]`

```json
[ { "county": "Orange",     "region": "Central",  "providers": 4, "openSlots": 30, "waitlisted": 9 },
  { "county": "Miami-Dade", "region": "Southern", "providers": 7, "openSlots": 27, "waitlisted": 33 },
  { "county": "Duval",      "region": "Northeast","providers": 4, "openSlots": 23, "waitlisted": 23 },
  { "county": "Broward",    "region": "Southeast","providers": 5, "openSlots": 21, "waitlisted": 24 } ]
```

Truncated — the seeded dataset returns 11 counties, ordered by
`openSlots` descending.

Two rows are worth reading together. Miami-Dade has the most providers
of any county (7) and still shows more people waiting (33) than open
slots (27). Hillsborough shows 4 providers, 6 open slots and 30
waiting — five waiting per opening. "Stretched" and "bottlenecked" are
different problems, and a statewide provider count hides both.

## 7. Public endpoints

| Path | Notes |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/auth/register` | |
| `POST /api/auth/login` | |
| `GET /swagger-ui.html`, `GET /v3/api-docs/**` | API documentation |

The statewide crisis-resource content is **not** an API endpoint. It is
static data in the frontend (`src/resources.js`, rendered by
`pages/StatewideResourcesPage.jsx`) on a
public route, so it renders with no network call and no authentication —
the point being that it works even if the backend is down.
